message: Bound FalkorDB to recent live state and require fresh multi-probe, multi-AS evidence so stale or broadly failing probes cannot dominate production incident detection
Added transit relationship drill-down with current endpoint-AS RIPE test evidence and ClickHouse loss/RTT history while explicitly avoiding causal claims about the selected hop
Guard empty FalkorDB aggregates and buffer JSON responses so non-finite values cannot produce HTTP 200 responses with empty bodies.
Define target incidents as packet-weighted, cross-network loss regressions from a healthy 24-hour baseline; exclude broadly failing probes and persistent ICMP non-responders.

Cache public RIPE Atlas probe inventory as FalkorDB node properties in a paced background worker; keep checked and successfully updated timestamps separate so unavailable IDs do not look enriched or trigger repeated requests.
Registered the existing IP detail API in the React router and added the missing IP topology page so every generated /ip link resolves to observed hop evidence.

Route correlation uses route-level ClickHouse history for commonality, per-hop baselines and multi-probe agreement for signal quality, and FalkorDB only for bounded live enrichment; correlated ICMP RTT is presented as investigation evidence rather than fault proof.
